events.summary: Asha leaves Bant, ensuring protection and order in her absence.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Tocasia begins a lesson on raw elemental magic for two brothers.
events.quote: There, before two wide-eyed brothers, she began a lesson on raw elemental magic.

events.summary: Snukk is flung toward a target and vows never to be tricked again.
events.quote: About halfway to the target, Snukk vowed that he had been tricked for the last time.

events.summary: The shards merge into the Maelstrom, fusing mana energies into monstrosities.
events.quote: As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.

events.quote: When we awoke, we found our trees transformed.
